summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction by a PDMR (Maya Martinez-Davis, President US) involving the acquisition of 8.955 notional American Depositary Shares at $53.32/share within her Executive Supplemental Savings Plan account. This is a routine internal plan transaction, not a public tender or capital markets event. The filing serves as a standard disclosure of director/PDMR shareholding under UK and SEC rules. No deal terms, premium, or corporate event are present. This filing does not represent a special situation.
